$comment: EvidenceCrew configuration. This is the UI and control layer ABOVE the harness.
It holds NO business truth. Projects, workspaces, tasks, workers and Git remain owned by the
harness and by each project .ai directory. This file only says where those live and how the
workbench behaves.
PATHS ARE RELATIVE TO THE REPOSITORY ROOT and are resolved by workbench/config.js, so a clone runs
from any directory. Environment variables can override each one; see docs/QUICKSTART.md.

workbench.name: evidencecrew
workbench.description: EvidenceCrew - a local control plane for verifiable multi-agent work.

server.$comment_host: Bind to loopback only. This is a local single-user tool and must not be reachable from the network.

paths.$comment_state: stateFile and logsDir are created on first run and are git-ignored. They hold this instance's own state, not project truth.

$comment: A Goal runs as a background job so the UI stays responsive and Pause has something to act on.
Strictly single-concurrency: one job at a time, matching the harness serialised operation model.
turnTimeoutMs bounds how long the workbench waits for a ChatGPT turn before surfacing BLOCKED
instead of hanging.
Permanent rules for this layer, enforced in code rather than by convention. The workbench never
stores ChatGPT credentials or cookies, never reads another Chrome profile, and never runs a
destructive git command.
Is an INDEPENDENT REVIEWER wanted, and may the Codex seat be used?
OFF       the supervisor reviews its own work. Records state review_level=SUPERVISOR_REVIEW and
independent_review_status=DISABLED_BY_POLICY. OFF never blocks a goal: a configured
choice is not a missing review, and the two are recorded differently on purpose.
ON        maps to AUTO: ask an independent provider only where a second opinion changes the
outcome (coding, architecture, high-risk writes, disputed verdicts).
REQUIRED  always ask. Only meaningful while the Codex seat has quota.
The UI toggle stores the RAW selection (ON stays ON); the server and the autonomous loop both
normalise it through protocol/policy.js. AWB_CODEX_MODE overrides this file for scripted runs.
